facts.text: The project is a Python module for flow control of the Tecan Genesis RSP 200 and other devices
The architecture translates steps into commands that the Tecan device reads via a serial connector
The module imports pyserial and opens a serial port
The serial link is opened at 9600 baud on /dev/ttyUSB0
Cmd_delayed queues (command, device) pairs and add_cmd appends one to cmdStack
Cmd_delayed.start sends GFC M1, every queued command, then GSC M1, and records each device in runningStack
A delayed command is the sequence letter + device + command, prefixed with STX, suffixed with ETX and an XOR byte, then a newline
do_cmd sends one command with the same STX/ETX/XOR framing and a rotating sequence letter
read collects the bytes between STX and ETX and returns the message that starts with @device
The init action sends PIS to device M1
The init_r action sends PIA to device R1 (the RoMa arm)
The init_l action sends PIA to device A1 (the LiHa arm)
The go_waste action sends PAA with the fixed waste coordinates to device A1
PSY sets the Y-spacing of the eight tips and takes the space in 0.1 mm, range [90...380]
The liha_spacey action sends PSY followed by the spacing to device A1
PAA positions are in 0.1 mm and their ranges are set by the SRA command and the init offset
The do_action dispatcher in the clone has init, init_r, init_l, move, go_waste and error-read branches but no halt or abort action
